title: Tesla's work on electron movement and transmutation

tellings.quote: but I think Tesla anyway was on this track of the movement of electrons allowed repositioning of just about every anything.

plain: The inventor Nikola Tesla, it is said, was on the track of an idea that moving electrons around could let you reposition, and so transform, just about any material. Harold Malmgren, a former presidential advisor who says he handled unexplained material, offers this to Jesse Michels as his own impression, without naming a source. If true, it would mean Tesla was reaching toward turning one substance into another.
